sources.title: Open Problems in Affine Differential Geometry and Related Topics
sources.inspection: Visual inspection of all three pages, with focus on item 1(a), its footnote, and the reference list. No additional completeness, convex-domain, globally injective dual-coordinate, or fixed-codimension requirement is stated.

sources.title: The Bonnet theorem for statistical manifolds
sources.inspection: Full PDF materialized; Introduction and Sections 2.1–2.4 inspected, including Theorem 2.2 and its local potential-extension proof. Statistical structures and induced connections match the audited convention.

sources.title: C1-statistical manifolds are statistical models
